# BLS CPI release snippets (real, public domain)

Trimmed excerpts of Table 1, each preceded by the head and "All items" row of the release's earlier summary table (which the parser must not read), from six archived BLS CPI news releases (2009, 2011, 2013, 2016, 2022, 2026), one per page layout (2016: revision footnote markers inside the All items row), for the release parser's tests (OD-0197). Cut by Claude from the bytes retained under OD-0189; re-cut under OD-0198 to add the summary rows; nothing else from the pages is included.

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, CPI-U (CUUR0000SA0), retrieved 2026-11-21. BLS.gov cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from BLS.gov. Quotation in documents is allowed under `bls_cpi`'s rights (OD-0188).
